tagline: Le logiciel des coachs sportifs indépendants
brief: Software for independent coaches in Morocco with 5 to 40 clients. It replaces WhatsApp DMs, voice notes and the spreadsheet: clients get a real training app, and the coach sees who is dropping off. The mark has to work as an app icon on black, as a favicon, and in the brand's gold on warm graphite, without leaning on the fitness clichés (dumbbells, bolts, flames, flexed arms).
criteria: Ownable in a category of dumbbells and lightning bolts, readable at 16 px, works in one colour, sits in the existing gold-on-graphite brand.

concepts.name: One Spine
concepts.idea: An f and a p on one stem: coach and client on the same backbone.
rationale: The f's crossbar runs straight into the p's bowl, so the two letters read as one piece
No dumbbell, no bolt: a letterform, so it stays ownable in a cliché-heavy category
A heavier small-size drawing keeps it legible as a 16 px favicon
Gold on warm graphite, the palette the site and the app already use

recommendation: One Spine in gold #D4AF37 on graphite #1C1A17, with the bone #F2EDE4 wordmark. On light grounds, use the graphite one-colour version.
next_steps: Swap the icons in frontend/public and site-coach for the web/ set
Replace the lightning-bolt SVG in the site header with the symbol
Run a trademark search before printing anything
